title: Aim Mark Block Pack
description: A minimalist Minecraft resource pack that adds a centered aim mark to blocks for a cleaner and more focused visual style.
body:
# Aim Mark Block Pack

Improve visual focus in Minecraft with subtle centered aim marks placed directly on block textures.

This resource pack adds a clean aim-point style marker to blocks, helping create a more precise and unique visual experience without changing the original Minecraft feel too much.

## Features
- Centered aim mark design
- Minimalist and clean style
- Vanilla-friendly textures
- Lightweight resource pack
- Smooth visual alignment

## Perfect For
- PvP players
- Precision building
- Minimalist texture setups
- Players who enjoy focused visuals

## Style
The pack keeps Minecraft's classic appearance while adding a modern aim-inspired texture detail that naturally blends into gameplay.

## Compatibility
Compatible with most Minecraft versions supporting resource packs.

## Installation
1. Download the resource pack
2. Move it to the resourcepacks folder
3. Enable it from Minecraft Resource Packs settings
4. Launch your world and enjoy the new visuals

## Notes
Designed for players who want a subtle but noticeable aiming reference directly on block textures.
